Scale for sort. v1's generator, at its shipped limit of 4 flags, writes 1,972,046 command lines from its reference grammar, 307,023 of them distinct (measured here, not run).
The agent ran sort 88 times before writing and about 960 times after, all hand-chosen or built by its own test scripts.

v1 is shown as the paper designs it (sections 2-6), not as run for this comparison. Counts marked 'measured here' come from v1's own generator and GNU coreutils 9.4 in the pash VM. Method, not quality, is compared.
